t27t run savings: int8 tensor cores forward, bf16 gradients

Forward GEMMs on int8 tensor cores, gradients in bf16: a run saves f x (1 - 1/s), 16% to 24%, or $16 to $24 of every $100. f, the share of a step in forward GEMMs, is not measured.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/t27t/t27t.t27 (gHashTag/t27#10789, PR #10790): the saving law saving_e3, the bench times and pick_path; t27c 0.5.2 test-report on the Railway lab, 8 of 8 tests pass, 3 invariants, 0 vacuous; tri t27t runs it
  • gHashTag/t27#10360: the GEMM bench, one RTX 4090, 2026-10-18, five training GEMM shapes, times printed to four digits; the int8 times are the best CUTLASS 3.5.1 s8 kernel, standing in for torch._int_mm, which was not timed itself
  • The rows f = 1/4 and f = 1/3 are the cost table #10360 printed; f = 1/5 and f = 1/2 are what-ifs from the same formula, shown because f has not been measured
